properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 7 PR 1): the small half of req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks, so "nothing found" in a hub never reads as nothing found anywhere. search_design adds `not_searched` (each pinned design by graph_id, its pin, where it could be read — export path or address — and why it was not searched: export present, export missing, at an address this search does not reach, or nowhere to read it) and `not_searched_note`. A pin naming no graph_id (a code dependency) is not listed; a design that pins nothing answers byte-for-byte as before. On a registry server an export path is named and never checked. Through a hub's view the merged search lists only pinned designs outside the view, each with `pinned_by`. The search that REACHES those designs is cap:search-design-reaches-the-designs-a-hub-tracks, still planned (phase 7 PR 2): distinct because this one searches nothing more, it only names what was not searched. MCP: upstream.rs pins_not_searched / not_searched_note, query.rs search_design, service/view.rs merged_search.
properties.name: A search on a design that pins others names every pinned design it did not search, and why
